long.title: TRUE or FALSE? Jaws & Disney Lied To You About These 12 Animals
long.comment:
📝 SCORE CHECK: how many did you get out of 12? 👇

Answer key: TRUE = river sharks + Nemo's dad. Everything else was FALSE.

Which movie lied to YOU the most? Comment it.
long.description:
TRUE or FALSE? Jaws, The Lion King, Finding Nemo and Bambi taught you some "facts" that aren't true... and two that are. Guess before the 3-second timer, keep score, and drop your score out of 12 in the comments 👇

0:00 Play along
0:23 A shark can smell one drop of blood from a mile away?
1:15 Great white sharks hunt humans?
1:59 All sharks have to keep swimming or they'll die?
2:41 Sharks can't get cancer?
3:17 Some sharks can swim up rivers into fresh water?
3:57 Goldfish only grow to fit their bowl, so a small bowl is fine?
4:46 Alligators live in the New York City sewers?
5:36 Hyenas are just scavengers that steal other animals' food?
6:16 Male lions do most of the hunting?
6:57 In real life, Nemo's dad would turn into Nemo's mom?
7:41 Mother deer stay with their babies all day?
8:24 Mice love cheese more than anything?
9:04 Scores

Subscribe for Part 4: monsters that turned out to be REAL.
